normal.title: Normal Type Weakness: Species List, Counters & Chart
normal.description: Normal type weakness is easy to misread once a second type is added. See counters, 4× exceptions, every tracked Normal species, and calculate it.
normal.intro: A pure Normal defender is easy to summarize and easy to misread once the second type is added. The species table shows the real weaknesses, including 4×.

fire.title: Fire Type Weakness: Switch Risks, Counters & 4× Pairs
fire.description: Fire type weakness checklist: switch-in risks, counter Pokémon and moves, every tracked Fire species with 4× results, and a dual-type calculator.
fire.intro: A Fire switch that resists one move can still lose the next one. See the counter moves, the 4× dual typings, and every Fire species in this dataset.

water.title: Water Type Weakness: Dual-Type 4× Traps & Counters
water.description: Water type weakness page for the 4× traps a second type creates, counter Pokémon and moves, every Water species we track, and a live calculator.
water.intro: Water is a common safe switch until the second type creates a 4× hole. The species table and calculator show that result before you lock the pick.

electric.title: Electric Type Weakness: Dual Typings, Counters & 4×
electric.description: Electric type weakness is only the start. Check every tracked Electric Pokémon second type, 4× exceptions, counters, and the live calculator.
electric.intro: Electric has a narrow defensive row, and the second type is where teams actually get surprised. Check counters, 4× exceptions, and each Electric species we track.

grass.title: Grass Type Weakness: Species 4× Results & Counters
grass.description: Grass type weakness breakdown with species-level 4× results, counter Pokémon and moves, every tracked Grass Pokémon, and a second-type chart.
grass.intro: Grass is a specialist, not a blanket answer. Each tracked Grass species below keeps its own weakness list, including the dual typings that reach 4×.

ice.title: Ice Type Weakness: Coverage Counters and Dual-Type 4×
ice.description: Ice type weakness versus using Ice as coverage: counter Pokémon, every tracked Ice species with 4× results, and a second-type calculator here.
ice.intro: Ice moves threaten four types, while an Ice Pokémon is the fragile one. Compare coverage counters with the Ice species that actually take the hit, including 4× cases.

fighting.title: Fighting Type Weakness: Immunity Traps & Counter List
fighting.description: Fighting type weakness guide for the immunity trap, counter Pokémon and moves, 4× dual typings, and every Fighting species we track in this dataset.
fighting.intro: Fighting coverage fails in a different way from a resisted hit. The immunity case, the counter Pokémon, and the 4× species are separated on this page.

poison.title: Poison Type Weakness: Dual-Type Exceptions & Counters
poison.description: Poison type weakness, continued: which dual typings cancel it, which Pokémon take 4×, and counters using the moves stored on each species page.
poison.intro: Poison looks simple until a partner type cancels a weakness or stacks a 4× hit. The tables below use this site’s chart on every Poison species we track.

ground.title: Ground Type Weakness: Immunity Cases, 4× & Counters
ground.description: Ground type weakness page for immunity blanks, 4× dual typings, counter Pokémon and moves, and every Ground species tracked in the dataset below.
ground.intro: Ground pressure and a Ground Pokémon are different problems. Immunity blanks, 4× dual typings, and counter moves are calculated from the same chart as the calculator.

flying.title: Flying Type Weakness: 4× Cases, Counters & Species
flying.description: Flying type weakness page covering 4× stacks, immunity exceptions, counter moves, and every Flying species tracked in the TypeMatchup chart.
flying.intro: Flying is as much an immunity as a weakness list. The calculator shows what a second type does to that row, including which species fall to 4×.

psychic.title: Psychic Type Weakness: Counters, Species & 4× Chart
psychic.description: Psychic type weakness answers past the overview: counter Pokémon, immunities that blank attacks, every tracked species, and the 4× pairs on this page.
psychic.intro: Psychic offense stops cold against one immunity, and Psychic defenders do not all share a weakness list. Counters, 4× pairs, and every tracked species are on this page.

bug.title: Bug Type Weakness: Generation Shifts, Counters & 4×
bug.description: Bug type weakness on the modern chart: counter Pokémon, stable 4× pairs, every tracked Bug species, and a dual-type calculator you can run here.
bug.intro: Bug’s chart row changed when new types arrived, and a Bug Pokémon still needs a second plan. Counters, 4× pairs, and tracked species are listed from the current 18-type chart.

rock.title: Rock Type Weakness: Hazard Role, Counters & 4× List
rock.description: Rock type weakness guide pairing hazard pressure with defensive holes: counters, 4× species, every tracked Rock Pokémon, and the calculator.
rock.intro: Rock rewards hazard chip and punishes Flying, then asks the Rock Pokémon to survive a long weakness list. 4× species and counter moves are both below.

ghost.title: Ghost Type Weakness: Counters, 4× Pairs & Calculator
ghost.description: Skip the one-line Ghost type weakness. See counter Pokémon, every Ghost we track with dual-type and 4× holes, then run the matchup calculator.
ghost.intro: An overview can name the weaknesses. This page adds counter Pokémon and moves, every Ghost species in our dataset with its real dual-type holes, and a calculator for the second type.

dragon.title: Dragon Type Weakness: Dual-Type 4× List & Counters
dragon.description: Dragon type weakness tools an overview leaves out: counter Pokémon with moves, every tracked Dragon 4× pairing, and a second-type calculator.
dragon.intro: Dragon matchups change with the second type. Use the counter list, the 4× species table, and the calculator instead of treating every Dragon as the same defender.

dark.title: Dark Type Weakness: Counter Pokémon, 4× Pairs & Chart
dark.description: Dark type weakness chart with counter Pokémon, 4× dual typings, and a full species list — not just the attacking types named in an overview.
dark.intro: The attacking types are the short version. The useful version is which Dark Pokémon take 4×, which partners erase a weakness, and which dataset Pokémon carry the counter move.

steel.title: Steel Type Weakness: Counter List Beyond Resistances
steel.description: Steel type weakness guide that goes past the resistance list: counter Pokémon, 4× dual typings, every tracked Steel species, and a calculator.
steel.intro: Counting resistances does not answer a Steel switch. The counter list, the 4× dual typings, and the species table show where Steel still loses.

fairy.title: Fairy Type Weakness: Dual-Type Chart & Counter List
fairy.description: Fairy type weakness guide for dual typings that change the result, 4× species, counter Pokémon and moves, plus an interactive type calculator.
fairy.intro: Fairy’s defensive reputation depends on the partner type. Run a second type in the calculator, then read the counter moves and the species that pick up a 4× weakness.
